lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular maxima arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the most intense nodes located in the mid-flank region above the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like structural pattern across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a distinct pixel intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow-induced lower intensity on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 discrete, small high-luminance spots across its lateral surface silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density clustering of significantly smaller, high-luminance spots is localized on the dorsal surface and along the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
